svg.title: Neural-QR version 2: implemented optical layout
svg.desc: Actual G32 phase-2 collection rendering with four finders, asymmetric bottom-right satellites, duplicated binary size codes, paired color phase cues, fixed palette strips and grid-8 references. The 32 by 32 matrix is rectified to 128 by 128 pixels. Colored outlines and labels are explanatory overlays, not transmitted marks. Four phases repeat one logical payload; G16 carries 128 gross bytes before reference and packet overhead.

g.text: Implemented collection layout · 16 colors · four palette phases · 4×4 camera pixels per cell
Dashed outlines and letter labels are explanatory overlays.
Their shape stays fixed across phases.
and reflection; the square core is retained.
Both copies must be clear and agree.
Top and bottom must agree in this exposure.
All 16 known colors measure camera color
distortion; these strips do not cycle.
Random data cells change color by phase.
Known grid-8 reference rows/columns stay fixed.
Four observations of the same logical payload
Phases add evidence, not four independent payloads. Reference cells keep their known colors.
G16 capacity: 16 × 16 cells × 4 bits = 1,024 bits = 128 bytes gross
Grid-8 leaves 169 data cells: 84 whole bytes + 4 bits, before packet framing and error correction.
4×4 camera pixels measure one color symbol. Sixteen colors encode 4 bits, not 16 bits, per symbol.
